create_soundspaces_simulator: create a SoundSpacesSim instance with a habitat config to initialize an audio-enabled 3D simulator
reset_simulator_episode: reset the SoundSpacesSim episode and return initial sensor observations
step_simulator_action: step the SoundSpacesSim with a discrete action and return updated observations
compute_oracle_actions: compute oracle actions for shortest path navigation from agent to sound source
get_current_audiogoal_observation: get the current binaural audiogoal observation with RIR convolution for the agent position
